onboardingParity: PairingScreen, ManualConnectionSheet, and PairingConfirmation match iOS PairingView and ManualTokenEntryView/ConnectionSheet 1:1: full-bleed centered Connect to Intent landing (without the top bar or extra footer copy on first-run onboarding), prominent Scan QR Code card with 64dp lime tile and iOS ConnectQR vector, transparent Manual Connection row with aligned 64dp surface tile and iOS ConnectManual vector, 44dp rounded Manual Connection bottom sheet with top-left Close button, uppercase eyebrow labels, three borderless 64dp surface fields (Host / Tailcat Address, Port, API Token with iOS clipboard paste and eye visibility icons), inline validation/probe error, and 64dp Connect button that immediately probes the TLS certificate and opens a single Verify Server Identity (Cancel / Trust & Connect) alert while keeping explicit Fetch certificate gating for untrusted deep links.
workspaceHeaderFade: The workspace list paints a theme-matched soft gradient below the grouping/search controls. It fades in with the initial scroll offset and keeps clipped rows from meeting a hard header edge without changing list padding or hit targets.
workspaceRowTimestamp: Workspace list rows show a compact relative activity timestamp (now, Xm, Xh, Xd, or short date after 7 days, matching iOS Date+Relative and WorkspaceRowView) aligned to the top-right corner of the title row instead of a separate full-date Activity row; workspace details retain the full timestamp.
workspaceDetailParity: Workspace detail matches iOS WorkspaceDetailView across header, Agents, Context, and Changes: removed stale Active/Idle state line and Workspace details button/dialog from the header, styled status summary as muted secondary text beside optional thumbnail, removed static Browser/Terminals/Scripts/New terminal button dump and Current/All filter chips and Search FAB from Agents and Context, updated AgentRow to flat borderless rows on canvas with top-right relative timestamps and no redundant Coordinator banner or Running text row, unified Context Notes and Files into collapsible sections on one scrollable screen without duplicate Spec subtitles, and aligned Changes tree rows flush left with compact branch and divider-separated commit rows.
workspaceTabsAndChangesParity: Workspace content tabs match iOS IntentContentSwitcher: 20dp surface track with 4dp inset, 48dp tabs, and a 16dp foreground pill that slides between tabs with a spring and no ripple. Changes matches iOS WorkspaceChangesView: collapsible uppercase UNSTAGED/STAGED/COMMITS (n) sections with a rotating chevron (shared with Context NOTES/FILES), empty-section text, file tree rows with folder/file icons, 22dp indentation up to depth 5 with 30% guide lines, monospace names, green/red line stats, status labels (Added, Deleted, Untracked, etc.) instead of raw git codes, folder counts and chevrons, and commit rows with author, short hash, and Pushed/Local labels separated by 10% dividers. Android ellipsizes long tree names instead of iOS horizontal scrolling.
launcherTransition: The Intent button morphs between the iOS 80dp circle and 48dp rounded-square close state, with coordinated glyph rotation, shrink and crossfade, a response-0.35/damping-0.85 spring, reversible animation and Android system duration-scale support. Per user direction, its open state uses the shared neutral grey surface and matching foreground, blended with the same animation progress. The modal keeps its anchor through both transitions, fades its scrim/tiles and preserves existing dismissal/action behavior.
iconParity: Android icons are converted 1:1 from the iOS Assets.xcassets SVGs (Close, ChevronLeft/Right/Down, More, Search, Check, Delete, Edit, Settings2, AddIcon, Connection, Night, ClockwiseArrow, ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down, Paperclip, File, Folder) instead of Material icons. Back buttons use the iOS chevron, overflow menus use the iOS vertical More dots, and every disclosure uses the iOS chevron (rotated when expanded) instead of text glyphs. Terminal arrow keys and suggested-prompt chips use the iOS arrows.
typographyAndSpacingParity: Typography tokens already match iOS Constants.Typography (Inter 40/28/18/16/14/12, weights 600/550/450, iOS tracking). Screen roles now match iOS: agent previews use bodyS (16), agent and workspace timestamps use subtextXXS (12), workspace row titles use bodyM semibold, root Context notes use bodyM with bodyS children, and workspace group headings use uppercase eyebrow. Spacing follows iOS WorkspaceDetailStyle and WorkspaceList: 64/32 heading padding with 20 between title, repository and summary, 8 above and 48 below the tabs, 36 between agent rows with 24 from avatar to text and 8 between title and preview, 48 between root notes and 24 between children without dividers, 32/12 around workspace group headings, and 20/10 workspace row spacing.
launchSplashParity: While a saved connection connects at launch, Android shows the iOS SplashArtView instead of the Connections list: the LaunchBackground light/dark gradients with the iOS intent_mark_twist_256 then looping intent_mark_pulse_256 Lottie animations at 100dp, tinted to the theme foreground (white in dark), and a static pulse frame when system animations are off. Like iOS .refreshable, the pull-to-refresh spinner appears only for user pulls; the first workspace load shows Loading workspaces… text.
notes: Android remains under development. The Intent menu close button uses the exact custom Close.svg path and 1.995 stroke from the referenced iOS asset, retaining theme tint and the existing morph animation. The Intent launcher now transitions between the referenced iOS circle/dandelion and rounded-square/close states with reversible spring motion, coordinated size/rotation/scale/crossfade, animated overlay entrance and system animation-scale support. Workspace rows omit description/status-message paragraphs, matching WorkspaceRowView; details retain the full summary. Workspace list corrections use iOS IntentDandelion artwork, left/right edge drawers with accessible heading actions; Android also opens them with a horizontal swipe that starts on the Workspaces heading row, because system Back covers most of the left edge, and Search beside Recent/Repo/Status with grouping preserved. Android retains system Back outside the central gesture exclusion area; archive actions remain in the heading menu. Earlier UI audit fixes reference iOS 1.1.9: Send beside Stop; paged/collapsible questions; compact queues; Tailcat-only manual pairing guidance and pinned trust; reconnect feedback; workspace grouping/search, canonical statuses and repository/PR/activity/attention metadata; detail headings, status images and summaries; inline tasks and relation links; creation source/branch choices and no specialist; transfer review, eligibility and retry; Assistant modal recovery; settings pairing and acknowledgements; workspace-first history; agent groups and watched links; local terminal names and expandable keys; numbered/wrappable text, external PDF readers and searchable Git details; saved browsers and documented script controls. Earlier transport, offline cache, comments, Markdown/Mermaid, attachments, Git, terminals and notifications remain. Preserve explicit TLS trust and Android Back. Not completed: top-level PR browsing, slash skills, note editing, synchronized terminal names, code/diff syntax highlighting, accessible PDF text, script creation/output/history and remaining iOS features. Native camera/permissions, Tailcat traffic, live reconnect/transfer/script actions, TalkBack/large text, tablet layouts and background notifications still need device checks. Notifications require a connected process and observe the active connection; taps do not switch hosts.
